# Neuromorphic_SensoryMotor_Loop

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A closed-loop system where sensory spikes are processed by the memristive SNN to directly generate motor commands, bypassing conventional von Neumann bottlenecks. Demonstrates a full TCC-iNEST integration, showing how topology-aware communication and neuromorphic computation can be unified.
